positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionDecision
positions.frame: what has been settled about the analytics database and when does the change take effect?
positions.why: src-1/src-4 both perform the same ratifying act — 'we are adopting Zypherion' and its bullet recap 'Database: Zypherion for analytics' — and src-3/src-6 both fix the same migration timeline in prose and bullet form. Conviction reads all four as 'decision' (settled operational fact, not argued claim), and register/style mark src-4/src-6 as the bolded-label recap of the same prose content in src-1/src-3, so the pairs cohere as one settled-decision record told twice, in two registers.

positions.name: ZypherionPerformanceJustification
positions.frame: what evidence is offered for why Zypherion outperforms the current setup on columnar queries?
positions.why: src-2 and src-5 both assert the identical '15x faster/improvement' columnar-query claim, once in prose and once in bullet recap form. Conviction marks both as 'claim' rather than 'decision' — evidence offered in support of, but distinct from, the adoption and timeline commitments — so they cohere as a separate justificatory read even though they sit alongside the decision material.
